claims.claim: EU-Southeast Asia goods trade reached 274.9 billion euros last year, up more than 50 percent from 177.9 billion euros in 2016.
claims.source_title: As the EU advances free trade with Southeast Asia, why is there no ASEAN-wide deal?
claims.supporting_quote: EU-Southeast Asia goods trade reached €274.9 billion ($313.7 billion) last year, up around 6% from the previous year and more than 50% from the €177.9 billion recorded in 2016, according to EU data.

claims.claim: Russia officially invited North Korean leader Kim Jong-un to visit the country, with the schedule to be coordinated through diplomatic channels.
claims.source_title: (LEAD) Russia invites N. Korean leader to visit: TASS
claims.supporting_quote: Russia has officially invited North Korean leader Kim Jong-un to visit the country, a Russian deputy foreign minister said, according to the TASS news agency Thursday. The schedule for the visit will be coordinated through diplomatic channels, the agency said.
